title: plugin-dashboard: a served, already-translated widget title (and a view tab) is re-translated by the packaged bundle, so a published edit shows the shipped string: objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20680
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). It is the objectui half that objectstack-ai/objectstack#20730's `domain:cli` seat measured, but could not file, because that session cannot reach this repo. The request was recorded on its seat post (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6024, `5909464490`). Triage found no objectui card for it on 2026-10-01 and files it here. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Graded here: `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue`.

## What was measured (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20730's dev, report `5908785750`; ACCEPT `5909346307`, out-of-scope finding, class a)

- **Setup:** in a browser, at the console's pinned objectui `db11afd4967c`, in `en` and `zh-CN`.
- **Served:** objectstack's `/api/v1/meta/dashboard` and `/api/v1/meta/view` responses carry the **published edit**. Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#20680 / PR #20728 and #20730 / PR #20832, the server applies the rule that an explicit override beats the packaged catalog.
- **Drawn:** the console draws the **shipped (packaged) string** over the served edit:
  - on the built-in `system_overview` dashboard's widget title;
  - on the `showcase_task.in_progress` view's tab and its breadcrumb.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `e2271568f8`)

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx:412`, `tWidgetTitle`. It takes the served `widget.title` as the **fallback**, and lets the bundle key `{ns}.dashboards.{dash}.widgets.{id}.title` win: "a bundle entry always wins over an inline map". So a served value the server has already translated, with the override applied, is re-resolved client-side, and the packaged catalog wins again.
- `tWidgetDescription` (`:422`) has the same shape.
- **The view path** (tab and breadcrumb) was not traced. The claim traces it first.

## Governing text

- objectstack's dashboard rule, stated in `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` by PR #20728 / #20832: an explicit override beats the packaged catalog.
- **The same principle was ruled for navigation labels** on objectui#11201: ruling B (`5921167691`) says a present label renders verbatim. The server is the one translation point for a served document.

## Direction (for the claim)

- **A served document is not translated twice.** When the dashboard or view comes from the server's `/meta` read (already resolved for the request's locale), the renderer draws the served title and description as given.
- The client-side bundle composition stays for documents the server did not translate: inline and preview documents. ⛔ No second translation pass over a served value, and ⛔ no copy of the server's override rule in the client.
- **Pins:**
  - a served widget title carrying a published edit renders as served, in `en` and `zh-CN`;
  - an unedited widget still shows the packaged translation (the server serves it translated);
  - an inline, non-served dashboard keeps the bundle composition (the control);
  - the view's tab and breadcrumb are pinned the same way once traced.
- **Then:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#20680 is served end to end once this card lands and a `.objectui-sha` bump carries it. objectstack-ai/objectstack#12438's E1 row waits on that.
